exact_claim_wording: Among corpus escalation cases with a shared case identifier and both a support-ticket creation timestamp and a first Engineering-escalation timestamp, more than half had the ticket created before the escalation.
subject: observable support-function escalation cases with stable identifiers and both timestamps
target_object: a support ticket created in more than half of eligible cases
conditions: strictly greater than 50%; stable shared TICK identifier; creation and first Engineering-escalation timestamps both present; duplicate or derived records counted once
verified_fields: five stable TICK identifiers; ticket-creation timestamps; first Engineering-escalation timestamps; support-function attribution; nonzero denominator
verification_notes: Five distinct audit-log cases satisfy the eligibility rule. Actor scope is the support function because escalation actions are attributed to the Support Lead. The held-out numerator and verdict were not calculated or exposed.
numerator_rule: count eligible unique cases whose ticket-creation timestamp strictly precedes first Engineering-escalation timestamp
denominator_rule: count unique stable TICK identifiers with both a ticket-creation timestamp and first Engineering-escalation timestamp; exclude missing timestamps and duplicate/derived records

exact_claim_wording: For every employee recorded as hired between 1 August 2025 and 31 July 2026, the available corpus contains a corresponding onboarding-checklist completion record dated within 14 calendar days of the employee's recorded start date.
subject: available corpus records for in-period hires
target_object: a corresponding checklist-completion record within 14 calendar days
organisational_scope: employees in phase2:org-chart-and-roster starting from 2025-08-01 through 2026-07-31
conditions: every means 100% of roster-derived eligible employees; compare recorded start date with identified completion record; record coverage only, not proof every onboarding activity occurred
verified_fields: roster_source; eligible_employee_identity; recorded_start_date; completion_record_identity; completion_record_date; 14_calendar_day_test; eligible_case_count
verification_notes: The named roster yields n=1: Yusuf Demir. COMMS-12 is dated 2025-09-05 and records checklist completion, within 14 days of roster start 2025-09-01, but its 'day 10' label conflicts with the four-calendar-day difference. No wider onboarding-practice generalisation is permitted.
numerator_rule: count roster-derived eligible employees with an identified checklist-completion record dated no more than 14 calendar days after recorded start date
denominator_rule: count employees in phase2:org-chart-and-roster with recorded start dates from 2025-08-01 through 2026-07-31
